Initial release of dingtalk-ai-table.

- Provides command-line access to DingTalk AI Sheet (multi-dimensional table) via mcporter CLI and MCP server.
- Supports creating tables, managing table structures, performing CRUD on fields and records.
- Includes sample workflows, batch operation scripts, and usage instructions.
- Details field types, typical use cases (data import/export, project/inventory management), and important notes.
- References API docs and error code documentation for further help.
